title: Learning to Model Optimization Problems from Solver Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2604.00442v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automating optimization modeling with LLMs is a promising path toward scalable decision intelligence, but existing approaches either rely on agentic pipelines built on closed-source LLMs with high inference latency or fine-tune smaller LLMs using costly process supervision that often overfits to a single solver API. We study how reinforcement learning from inexpensive outcome labels can improve optimization modeling and support reuse across heterogeneous solver environments. To this end, we propose Optimization Modeling from Solver Outcomes (OMSO), which uses reinforcement learning (RL) with a mathematical programming solver as a deterministic, interactive environment. Given a natural-language problem and a target solver, OMSO generates solver-specific code, executes it in a sandboxed harness, and converts execution outcomes into scalar rewards in a closed-loop generate-execute-feedback-update process. translated_title: 从求解器结果中学习建模优化问题
translated_abstract: 用大语言模型（LLM）实现优化建模自动化是迈向可扩展决策智能的一条有前景的路径，但现有方法要么依赖基于闭源LLM构建的智能体流水线（推理延迟高），要么使用代价高昂的过程监督来微调较小的LLM，且这些方法往往过拟合于单一求解器API。我们研究了如何利用廉价的基于结果的标签进行强化学习，以改进优化建模并支持在异构求解器环境之间的复用。为此，我们提出了基于求解器结果的优化建模方法（Optimization Modeling from Solver Outcomes, OMSO），该方法使用强化学习（RL），将数学规划求解器作为确定性的交互式环境。给定一个自然语言问题和目标求解器，OMSO生成求解器特定的代码，在沙盒环境中执行该代码，并将执行结果转换为标量奖励，形成闭环的“生成-执行-反馈-更新”流程。这种RL框架学习优化……
tldr: 提出OMSO框架，将数学规划求解器作为确定性交互环境，通过沙盒执行结果转化为奖励信号进行强化学习，实现低成本、可跨异构求解器复用的优化建模自动化。
en_tdlr: Proposes OMSO, a reinforcement learning framework that treats a mathematical programming solver as a deterministic interactive environment, converting sandboxed execution outcomes into reward signals to enable low-cost, solver-agnostic automation of optimization modeling.
